column1: #note:HH rates measured with a CEST NMR approach at pH 7.65 in 10% D2O/90% H2O and 50 mM sodium phosphate at 298 K. Only residues with 15N chemical shift differences between the ground and excited state of more than 1 ppm were included to ensure robust rate estimates. Only residues for which the lower bound rate (value - error) was positive were included.
